name: +1 Power Per Click
creator: 67 POWER
redeem: Launch +1 Power Per Click and give the world a moment to fully load.
Click the Settings gear button on the right side of the screen, near the top.
Find the code entry box inside the Settings menu.
Type or paste the code exactly as written, capitals included, and press Redeem.
notes:
+1 Power Per Click is a clicker game released in July 2026 by the verified Roblox group 67 POWER. Every click adds to your Power, and you spend that Power breaking through walls to earn Wins, unlock stronger swords, and move on to new worlds. Rebirths reset your run for permanent bonuses, while pets and Titles add further multipliers.

Codes mostly give timed potions that double Power, Wins, or luck, plus batches of Title rolls, so redeeming several back to back makes a single play session much more productive. The developers add codes when the game passes visit or player milestones and when a new world launches, and they list the current ones in the game description and on their Discord server.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming +1 Power Per Click codes?
faq.a: Most codes work straight away, but some codes in this game only work after you reach a set number of rebirths. If one fails, rebirth a few more times and try again.

faq.q: Where does the +1 Power Per Click developer post new codes?
faq.a: The developer, the Roblox group 67 POWER, lists current codes in the game's description on its Roblox page and on its Discord server. New codes tend to arrive when the game passes a visit or player milestone, or when a new world launches.

faq.q: What are the Title rolls from codes like 2XALL, TITLELUCK and TEMPLE for?
faq.a: Titles add their own multiplier alongside pets and rebirths, and Title rolls are how you try for a better one. 2XALL gives 100 Luck Title Rolls, while TITLELUCK and TEMPLE each give 100 Title Rolls.

faq.q: Should I type +1 Power Per Click codes in capital letters?
faq.a: Yes. Enter each code exactly as written, capitals included, in the code box in the Settings menu. All current codes are in capitals, such as WORLD6 and JUNGLE.
